pages.title: Charm Magazine
pages.text: The Talisman Pocket lets you carry several folded talismans together with spare paper. Every folded talisman inside remains active, so you can prepare several different protections at once.

Right-click the pocket, or click it in your inventory, to arrange your talismans. Spare paper is automatically folded to fill empty talisman slots. The tooltip also shows what is stored inside and how many uses remain.
